title.en: Gradient Buttons · Sea Blue CSS Gradient Button

description.zh: 在单按钮页对照实际按钮与两种色值。 CSS渐变按钮目录，按名称展示配色预览，并在具体按钮页提供色值及完整CSS。已浏览两页目录和Sea Blue实际按钮；公开样式代码可读，价格、代码再许可及复制后的商用权限尚未知。
description.en: A directory of named CSS gradient buttons with rendered previews, color values and complete CSS on individual button pages. We viewed two directory pages and the Sea Blue button. Its style source is publicly readable; pricing, redistribution licensing and commercial permission for copied CSS remain unknown.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Gradient Buttons (https://gradientbuttons.colorion.co/).
Technology stack: css.
Component specification: 在单按钮页对照实际按钮与两种色值。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在两页目录里比较了蓝紫、橙红、紫青等渐变按钮，再进入 Sea Blue 查看具体实现。目录中的按钮沿用相同版式与基础规则，主要差别是配色；详情把实际按钮与两种色值并列，完整 CSS 另在下方源码区。原代码给出背景尺寸和悬停位移规则，但本次没有悬停、复制或筛选，价格及 CSS 复制后的商用许可仍需另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
